holes_found.description: INCOMPLETE FIX of c6 hole0 (ISS-3059, closed 2026-08-11T02:08Z). The patch swapped detail_extra paragraph 1 enumeration from "2,534 km moon altitude" to "4,750 km Polaris", which DID resolve the paragraph-1-vs-paragraph-2 enumeration mismatch. But it did NOT remove the false-impossibility sub-claim c6 hole0 also flagged — it merely moved it onto a different member. Paragraph 1 now reads: "...the function can never reach the three distinct heights (9,572 km from Schumann, 9,086 km from model parameterization, and 4,750 km Polaris) the dome claims it simultaneously reconciles." This asserts H(r) can never reach 4,750 km, which is demonstrably false: 4,750 < sup H(r) = 8,537 km, so H(r) = 4,750 km at r = 8619*ln(8537/4750) = 5,053 km, well inside the disc (R = 20,015 km). Paragraph 2 of the SAME field contradicts paragraph 1 explicitly — it says only "Both 9,572 km and 9,086 km exceed this bound" and later calls Polaris 4,750 km "the sole plausible match" that H(r) CAN match. So the intra-field para1-vs-para2 contradiction c6 flagged persists, and our supremum-violation kill-shot still lists a reachable value among the unreachable ones. The core kill (9,572 and 9,086 both exceed 8,537 km — verified true) is untouched and stands.
holes_found.recommendation: Apply the alternative fix c6 hole0 explicitly offered (and which the decider did not take): in detail_extra paragraph 1, stop lumping 4,750 km into "can never reach." Either (a) narrow the claim to the two super-ceiling values — e.g. "the function can never reach two of the three heights the dome claims it reconciles (9,572 km from Schumann and 9,086 km from model parameterization both exceed sup H(r) = 8,537 km); only Polaris at 4,750 km is reachable, and it fails separately on the 10% self-inconsistency argued below" — or (b) drop the parenthetical triple in the leading sentence and let paragraph 2 carry the (correct) two-value supremum argument. Either edit removes the false sub-claim and aligns para1 with para2. Decider should file a NEW issue (or reopen ISS-3059) since the closed ISS-3059 patch only partially resolved c6 hole0.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A fair-minded dome defender grants our supremum-violation math and pivots: "The 26% damping is not an invented free parameter — it is the SAME lossy-cavity correction the globe model itself requires. Schumann-1952 ideal cavity gives 10.59 Hz; the measured 7.83 Hz is 26% lower for BOTH models, and Sentman only recovers it by feeding in measured ionospheric conductivity. If the dome is guilty of a post-hoc 26% correction, so is mainstream physics — you are applying an asymmetric standard."
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Our text already preempts this but the contrast should stay sharp and prominent: the globe 26% is fixed by INDEPENDENTLY MEASURED conductivity profiles sigma(h) (externally constrained, falsifiable — Sentman 1990/1995), whereas the dome supplies NO independently measured aetheric loss tangent, so its 26% is fit purely to close the 10.59->7.83 gap (data/wins.json:WIN-002.detail_evidence already states "no independently measured aetheric loss tangent is ever provided, making the 26% a post-hoc free parameter rather than a prediction"). Keep that sentence load-bearing; do not let future edits trim it. The asymmetry defense collapses the moment the reader sees the globe correction is measured and the dome correction is fit.
